title: APPROVAL OF NOTICE OF MUTUAL AGREEMENT FOR ALAMEDA CORRIDOR CALENDAR YEAR 2027 OPERATIONS AND MAINTENANCE BUDGET
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - APPROVAL OF NOTICE OF MUTUAL AGREEMENT FOR ALAMEDA CORRIDOR CALENDAR YEAR 2027 OPERATIONS AND MAINTENANCE BUDGET
Transmittal 1
Summary
: Staff requests adoption of a Resolution approving and providing mutual agreement, via Notice of Mutual Agreement (NMA) No. 2026-3 amongst the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department), Port of Long Beach (POLB), BNSF Railway (BNSF), and Union Pacific Railroad (UPRR), for the Calendar Year (CY) 2027 Alameda Corridor (AC) Operations and Maintenance (O&M) budget in the total amount of $48,891,031. Funding for the O&M budget is provided by the BNSF, UPRR, and Alameda Corridor Transportation Authority (ACTA) Reserve Account. This NMA aids in implementing the following three objectives of the Port of Los Angeles (POLA) 2026-2030 Strategic Plan: “World Class Infrastructure that Promotes Growth”; “Secure, Efficient, and Environmentally Sustainable Supply Chain;” and “Improved Financial Performance of Port Assets.” A properly, safely maintained and operated AC is vital for shippers (importers, exporters, and their intermediaries) and thus addresses these objectives. There will be no financial impact to the Harbor Department if this NMA is approved.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve and provide Mutual Agreement through NMA No. 2026-3 for the CY 2027 Alameda Corridor O&M budget in the total amount of $48,891,031; 3) authorize the Executive Director or designee with delegated authority to approve subsequent Mutual Agreements for the allocation and use of contingency funds within the total budget, and for the transfer of funds to/from Maintenance of Way budget items as needed; 4) direct the Executive Director to transmit this Resolution to ACTA for further action pursuant to the Amended and Restated Alameda Corridor Use and Operating Agreement; and 5) adopt Resolution No. _________________.
